scope: Live Claude-only F1a QA in steven, using the correctly built latest-main Relay binary and new QA-only template delay. A 60s smoke delay was interrupted promptly; Coder recorded canceled_at and a terminal failed job. The specified 5m/8m trial and a separate 2m/8m exploratory trial each received only attempt 0, an applied non-retryable nack, terminal failed with canceled_at, and natural workspace deletion. No provider redelivery was observed before either deadline, so branch A and branch B were not exercised. Private source logs contain the signed work-order claim times and build logs; only redacted timestamps, binary provenance and reviewed screenshot crops are public. The original safe pool config was restored, latest-main binary retained, both QA pools healthy, no workspace left. Cursor was not prompted.
